tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la bstod pa rje dbang phyug rab brtan pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+ya/ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i rnam rol kun dga'i mtshan/ /gangs can skye dgu'i mnga' bdag khyod gcig pu/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgon khyod bskal brgya'i bar/ /zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs la byin gyis rlobs/ /bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa thub dbang gi /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab deng sang khyod min su/ /bsam bzhin bka' drin can khyod bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /bskal brgyar brtan bzhugs thub bstan nyin mor mdzod/ /khyad par 'dzam gling mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma bdag chen chos kyi rje/ /rdo rje gdan 'dir mi nub srid gnyis kyi/ /bstan pa rgyas shing bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /mthong bas yid kyi gdung sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /brtse bas 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i 'gran bral rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma srung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /rnal 'byor rigs sngags grub pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /bstan pa'i gtso bo dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /lugs gnyis dge legs dpal 'byor yar 'phel shog /ces pa bdag gi bla ma ngag dbang kun dga'i mtshan can la bstod pa gdan bzhugs dang bcas pa 'di ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa tshar chen yab sras kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gus pa'i sems kyis legs par sbyar ba bstan pa dang 'phrin las mkha' khyab tu 'bar zhing rgyun ring du brtan par gyur cig yi ge pa ni rje nyid kyi bka' drin kho nas 'tsho zhing gsung las skyes shing / srid zhu ba rnam sras gling pa 'jam dbyangs kyis gus pas bris so//

//sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ bstod pa rje dbang phyug rab brtan pas mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
